I can't give you the letter for q3. A quiz is meant to measure what you can do, so I don't hand out answers before it's graded. That applies to practice retakes too, and your two attempts at quiz 0001 haven't been graded yet. I also can't narrow it down by ruling options in or out.

Here's a way to work it out yourself. Take a scenario you already understand from the agent loop: the model asks for an action, the action runs, and the result comes back. Then walk through what happens when the same edit repeats.

1. Write down what the model sees after each repeat. Does the result that comes back differ from the one before, or is it identical?
2. Ask what the model has to go on when it decides its next step. It only knows what's in the text it was given.
3. Read each option and ask: "If this were the cause, what would I expect to see in the loop?" Then check which option matches the situation in the stem.

Try this on your own first. Then tell me, in your own words, why you think the agent keeps making the same edit. If you reply with your reasoning, I'll tell you whether your thinking holds up, without confirming any letter.

It also helps your mission. Your makerspace assistant will have a booking tool, and a loop that retries the same failing booking is a real failure mode you'll need to design against.

If you'd like, I can grade your submissions now. Once they're graded, we can go through q3 together in full, including the "why" you wanted to read up on.
